validity.researcher_notes: LOUD FLAG for the whole cluster (see identical note on every row in this brief): SNGPL's Annual Report 2018, pages 32-35 ('TRANSMISSION SYSTEM As at June 30, 2018', https://www.sngpl.com.pk/download/AnnualReport-2018/SNGPLAR-2018.pdf), is a text-searchable, per-segment listing of the ENTIRE SNGPL network (Sr.No / SECTION / DIA / MAINLINE km / LOOPLINE km) -- exactly the engineering-document class the brief hoped the 'MP 59.91' milepost would lead to. Row 113 reads 'FSD - SHAHDARA / 16in / mainline 57.48 km / loopline 119.25 km' -- the LOOPLINE figure is an EXACT match to this row's LengthKnown (119.25) and Diameter (16), confirming this row is specifically the loopline portion of the FSD-Shahdara corridor (the mainline portion + a separate 24in loopline make up the sibling row P4136 = 57.48+55.03=112.51, also exact). The register itself is a point-in-time snapshot with no addition/commissioning dates, so it does not resolve StartYear1 -- but it independently confirms GEM's spec data traces to SNGPL's own books, and 'loopline' status supports treating this as a later capacity-addition pipe laid alongside an older mainline, not a single-vintage asset.
